claims.text:
J.R.R. Tolkien noted that it was a custom in the Bolger family to use high-sounding names and that he turned them into old names of Frankish and Gothic origin. The name Rudigar contains hrod "fame" and gar "spear". It is the Middle High German form of Old English Hrothgar and modern Roger. It is cognate with the modern german name Rüdiger.

claims.text: The son of Adalgar Bolger and husband of Belba Baggins, Rudigar became head of the Bolger Family as the eldest heir. He had one son, Herugar.
